author: Latham, 1790
habitat: 섬의 숲 가장자리, 마을 주변의 덤불과 개울가
summary: 국내에서는 2004년 5월 홍도에서 처음 기록된 뒤 2010년 소청도, 2013년 외연도 등 서해 섬에서 봄에만 몇 차례 관찰된 길잃은새다. 히말라야와 인도에서 중국 남부, 인도차이나, 말레이반도를 거쳐 자바·발리까지 분포하며, 중국에서는 주로 양쯔강 이남에서 번식한다. 겁이 많아 우거진 숲 바닥의 낙엽 사이에서 곤충과 열매를 찾고, 새벽과 해 질 녘에 더 활발하다.

points.ko: 옅은 뺨의 흐린 검은 세로줄 두 개
points.en: two diffuse dark vertical bars on paler cheeks
white-tipped median coverts forming a wing-bar

sexes.male: 머리와 가슴, 배가 짙은 주황색이고 등과 날개, 꼬리는 푸른 회색이며, 가운데날개덮깃 끝의 흰 무늬가 날개에 흰 점줄을 만든다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 전체 색이 칙칙하고, 등과 날개가 푸른 회색 대신 올리브 갈색을 띤다.

young: 어린새는 머리와 등이 갈색을 띠고 등과 어깨깃에 옅은 세로 반점이 있으며, 아랫면은 흐린 주황빛 흰색 바탕에 검은 가로무늬가 있다. 날개덮깃 끝의 무늬도 흰색이 아니라 담황색이다.

art.subject: Orange-headed Thrush (Geokichla citrina), adult male in spring, of the East Asian form with a barred face: crown, nape, breast and belly bright orange, the colour meeting the blue-grey of the mantle cleanly on the lower nape; cheeks and throat paler, whitish-buff, crossed by two dark vertical bars, one running down from below the eye and one at the rear of the ear-coverts; vent and undertail coverts white; back, rump, wing coverts and tail uniform blue-grey, the flight feathers darker grey; a narrow white bar on the median coverts; dark bill; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: standing on leaf litter on the forest floor, side view
art.scene: shaded broadleaf forest floor on a Korean offshore island in May, dappled light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing on leaf litter: deep orange crown, nape, breast, belly and flanks, paler cheeks crossed by two diffuse dark vertical bars below the eye, bluish-grey back, wings and short square tail, broad white tips to the median coverts forming a bar, dark bill, pinkish legs

adult female, side view standing: orange head and underparts slightly duller than the male, the same two diffuse dark bars on the cheeks, olive-toned brown back, wings and tail, white-tipped median coverts, pinkish legs
art.build: A medium-sized, plump ground thrush, slightly smaller than a Dusky Thrush, with a large rounded head, a short tail and fairly long legs. Bill straight, slightly shorter than the head. Legs pinkish. Tail short and square. Shy, hopping and feeding on the shaded forest floor.
avoid: Do not paint a plain orange face; the cheeks and throat are whitish-buff with two dark vertical bars, one below the eye and one behind the ear-coverts.
Do not paint the head black or the breast spotted; the crown, nape and breast are plain orange.
Do not paint brown upperparts on the male; they are blue-grey (females are olive-brown above).
Do not paint the vent orange; it is white.
